beast.aspect-level.shows: The beastcraft adds the Level 20 Aspect of the Avian skill to the boots, not a Level 30 version.

dominance.pairs.shows: The Orb of Dominance removes one of the crown's three influenced modifiers and upgrades another, and every ordered pair of those modifiers is equally likely.

eldritch.dominance-ties.shows: The boots carry a tier 2 Searing Exarch implicit and a tier 2 Eater of Worlds implicit, so neither side is dominant and the eldritch exalted orb is refused.

eldritch.ember-tier.shows: Every result gives the boots one Searing Exarch implicit of tier 2, the tier of a Greater Eldritch Ember.

eldritch.not-influenced.shows: The ember is refused because the crown is influenced.

recombine.inputs.shows: The recombinator takes two rare amulets of the same item class, so the pair is accepted and the recombine itself is not computed in this pass.

recombine.count_table.shows: The two amulets pool their prefixes and suffixes, which is the count that the table turns into the chances of keeping zero, one, two or three modifiers on a side.

recombine.count_table_alt.shows: The two amulets show the pooled modifiers that the alternate table counts when a side pools six or more of them.

recombine.one_prefix_one_suffix.shows: Each amulet contributes one prefix and one suffix, the shape that the rule keeps at most one of each of when the result is magic.

recombine.selection_alpha.shows: The two amulets carry four different modifiers, which are the modifiers whose selection weight the result would draw by.

recombine.exclusive_weight.shows: The two amulets carry modifiers from different groups, which is the case where the group-exclusivity rule decides which modifiers can survive together.

recombine.non_native.shows: Both amulets are the same base type, so the non-native modifier rule is not exercised by this pair; the recombine result is not computed in this pass.

recombine.output_rarity.shows: Both inputs are rare, so the rule makes the result rare; the recombine itself is not computed in this pass.

recombine.base_properties.shows: The two amulets show the base properties, such as the implicit modifier, that the result takes from one of the inputs.

recombine.cost.shows: The step costs one Jewellery Recombinator; the Thaumaturgic Dust and gold in the rule are outside the item model, so the catalogue cannot show them.

recombine.base_and_item_level.shows: Both amulets are rare and item level 84, the inputs whose base type and item level the result rule chooses between.

recombine.pools_and_groups.shows: The four modifiers on the two amulets belong to four different groups, which are the pools that the group rule draws from.

reforge.guarantee-first.shows: The reforge first adds the Hatred modifier that the essence guarantees for boots, and then leaves the remaining modifiers to the count table.

veiled-chaos.replaces-one.shows: The reforge keeps the prefixes, clears the suffixes, and leaves the veil to the pending fill, where it replaces one of the reforge's modifiers on that modifier's side.

reforge.counts-scope.shows: Suffixes Cannot Be Changed keeps the three suffixes, and those three count toward the reforge's total of four, five or six explicit modifiers, so the reforge adds only the one, two or three prefixes that fit in the open prefix slots.

harvest.damage-conversion.shows: The ring holds a modifier of the FireDamage type, so the craft applies, and the conversion itself stops at the unverified rule.

beast.talisman-fracture-cost.shows: The rare Talisman has four modifiers, so the one-modifier fracture is offered, and it costs one Farric Frost Hellion Alpha.
The rare Talisman has six modifiers, so the two-modifier fracture is offered, and it costs one Fenumal Plagued Arachnid and one Black Mórrigan.

add.side-first.shows: The rare jewel has room on both sides, so the exalted orb picks a side first, one half of the probability for each, and then a modifier on that side by weight.

essence.ignores-metamods.shows: The rare crown carries Suffixes Cannot Be Changed and three suffixes, and the essence clears the suffixes anyway: the result holds only the ColdResistance modifier that the essence guarantees.

classes.tincture-limits.users: `rules/v2/item-classes.json`, which gives the Tincture class its affix limits
classes.tincture-limits.shows: A magic tincture holds one prefix and one suffix, while the class allows no rare tincture at all, so a rare tincture has zero prefix slots and zero suffix slots.

quality.amounts.users: no current method or data file; it records the pre-3.25 quality amounts, superseded by the checked rule `quality.per-level`
quality.amounts.shows: No item fixture exercises this rule, because the quality currencies now stop at a result that needs item data.

catalyst.amounts.users: no current method or data file; it records the pre-3.25 catalyst amounts, superseded by the checked rule `quality.per-level`
catalyst.amounts.shows: No item fixture exercises this rule, because the catalyst methods now stop at a result that needs item data.
